role: Independent geometric experiment planner and changed-copper review
status: Final Source24d independently rerun and bound to actual native capture and current 150-file source manifest
scoreScope: Whole-board routing judgment informed by scoped independent checks of every physically changed/new trace and new/relocated barrel. No duplicate full-board continuity or manufacturability acceptance claim.
confidence: High on measured changed geometry; moderate on subjective overall routing score.
ratingReasoning: Actual changed copper improves critical local geometry: PD protected bypass span falls from 23.026 to 3.174 mm; CdVdt inner2 trunk falls from 8.306 to 2.981 mm; LOW gate inner2 span falls from 22.342 to 20.409 mm; VC local span falls from 10.106 to 7.609 mm.

Inner1 non-ground copper decreases 38.244 mm, from 327.930 to 289.687 mm. The implemented SAFE_EN middle migration is physically present and its two all-layer barrels clear regenerated foreign ground copper.
Whole-board centerline drops 34.280 mm (0.84%); total barrel count rises one to 434. This is useful local improvement with a modest whole-board economy gain, rather than a major placement redesign.

All 27 physically changed traces and 11 new/relocated barrel positions pass independent analytic foreign-copper, NPTH/drill, endpoint owner, board-edge and octilinear checks against actual final native geometry.

residuals.geometry: Exactly 0.200000 mm foreign gap to GND barrel pcb_via_386 on inner2. Passes declared geometry at numerical tolerance but has no nominal clearance margin.
Still 81.922 mm planar after 8.670 mm saving; substantial placement/corridor detour remains.
Still 55.705 mm; only 0.374 mm was removed, and the longer routing architecture remains.
289.687 mm non-ground signal copper remains on inner1. SAFE_EN plane relief adds two full-through signal barrels, so conservative complete path length grows despite slight planar shortening.
Shorter affected LOW/VC spans do not compact the unchanged power-component placement or prove electrical switching stability.

limitations: Full-board connectivity, whole-board shorts, ground reference/contact, JLC footprint preservation, source contracts and exported copper acceptance are other roles' checks.
Static ideal native geometry does not establish manufacturing tolerances, thermal/EMI behavior, compensation stability or bench switching behavior.

finalNativeGeometryFacts.acceptanceMethod: Fresh Source24d scoped checks; prior acceptance flags are not reused.
